params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$repo=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'local-ai-workspaces\mhw-mods'
$wt=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'agent-worktrees\complete-workflows-final-20260929-chatgpt-a1'
git -C $repo fetch origin --prune
git -C $repo worktree prune
if(Test-Path $wt){ throw ('worktree path already exists: '+$wt) }
git -C $repo branch -D 'local/complete-workflows-final-20260929-a1' 2>$null | Out-Null
git -C $repo worktree add -b 'local/complete-workflows-final-20260929-a1' $wt origin/main
$env:OPENCODE_CONFIG='C:\Users\Xxkan\HeavenBridge\opencode-fallback.json'
$oc='C:\Users\Xxkan\local-ai-tools\opencode\package\bin\opencode.exe'
Push-Location $wt
try {
  $prompt=@'
You are the final integration engineer for fengie/mhw-mods. This is the last ordinary branch preventing branch-zero.

Read AGENTS.md and all current repository instructions first. Reconstruct current origin/main before editing. The historical source branch is origin/codex/complete-mod-workflows at cae2407e5245ab27339967f2b5522a37c1e60152; its primary implementation commit is 02fa1dd5c3e98d319067043598bfdfd32617e65f.

DO NOT merge/replay that branch wholesale. Its old continuity/version/verification/CI history is stale. Selectively port only useful product code, tests, and durable docs onto this fresh current-main worktree, preserving every newer behavior/invariant on main.

Must reconcile these genuinely missing or still-useful capabilities where compatible with current architecture:
- FOMOD installer service + chooser UI, including safe archive-import choice flow and remembered selections.
- Smart Inbox must detect FOMOD packages and leave the original source untouched for interactive import; preserve current SafeRecursiveTraversal and modern ExtractSafelyAsync containment signatures.
- Rules editor, update migration, game adapter SDK/contract, workflow analysis, workflow UI, and WORKFLOWS/GAME-ADAPTER-SDK docs.
- Richer collection recipe format/import/preview behavior and its tests/self-test.
- Crash bisector interaction/ddmin improvements, while preserving current main's control/baseline and full-suspect validation, cancellation correctness, process cleanup, and only confirming a single culprit when actually isolated.
- Still-relevant conflict/planner/deployment/storage changes and focused workflow tests, but do not regress current safety, containment, launch atomicity, profile identity, updater, or UI behavior.

Keep current main versions of CHANGELOG/version identity, _AGENT_CONTEXT continuity/checkpoint files, .verification cache, and current CI unless a narrowly necessary current-main-compatible edit is required. Do not import historical evidence dumps merely to preserve branch history.

Resolve product conflicts semantically, not by taking theirs/ours wholesale. Prefer adding missing new files first, then adapt integration points to current APIs.

Verification before commit:
1. git diff --check
2. dotnet build MhwModManager.sln -c Release -m:1 -warnaserror
3. run the relevant Core/Automation/Storage/Integration test assemblies produced by the Release build, especially workflow/FOMOD/recipe/crash/deployment tests; run broader backend suites if available and bounded.
4. run the self-test if it builds and is applicable.

Fix any failures caused by this port. Do not weaken tests. Commit one coherent reconciliation commit locally. DO NOT push anywhere. End by printing: BASE origin/main SHA, FINAL HEAD SHA, files changed, exact verification commands/results, and any limitations.
'@
  & $oc run --standalone --auto --model 'ollama/qwen2.5-coder:7b' --format json $prompt
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'LOCAL_AGENT_FAILED' }
  Write-Output '=== FINAL_STATUS ==='
  git status --short
  git rev-parse HEAD
  git log -3 --oneline
  git diff --check origin/main...HEAD
} finally { Pop-Location }
